infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Document Risk Analyzer uses your camera so you can photograph the pages of a document. The photos are read to extract the document's text, which is then redacted of personal details and analyzed. For example, you can take a picture of a printed lease to check it for risky clauses.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Document Risk Analyzer never records audio. It only takes still photos of documents, so you will not be asked for microphone access.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Document Risk Analyzer accesses your photo library only when you choose to pick photos of a document. The selected photos are read to extract the text for analysis. For example, you can select a saved photo of a signed lease to check it for risky clauses.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to connect to the local development server while developing.
